examples.en: Psychologist and behavioral scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.

examples.en: This is the age women start to become "invisible"—our value, attractiveness and power supposedly diminished by the vanishing of youth.
examples.zh: 这是女性开始变得“不受人关注”的年龄——据说我们的价值、吸引力和力量会因为青春消逝而削减。
